quadrature_check: cached joint_kg_interface.json; 3 and 5 nodes per dimension chose the same action, with score difference at most 0.00007001
common_information: all arms share the 96 public policies, original eight-point initial design, source-learned billing mean support and coefficient moments; only risk prior and search allocation differ
paid_update: exact joint Gaussian sample-mean and log-sample-variance likelihood under the frozen finite risk bank, with conditional Gaussian coefficient updates
acquisition_and_recommendation: same finite-verifier utility under correlated Gaussian posterior moments; 27 centered Gaussian fantasies retain mean-risk covariance; finite-particle terminal utility is diagnostic
fantasy_noise: objective 0.12^2/n; constraint E[particle episode variance]/n; log sample variance trigamma((n-1)/2); observation-noise cross covariance zero
budget_shift: learner stores residual cost relative to source budget 1; actual constraint mean is this value plus 1 minus the public target cost budget
search_stream: SeedSequence(noise_seed,0,policy_index,visit_count), shared across arms and public cost budgets
verification_stream: SeedSequence(noise_seed,1,policy_index,verification_replicates), independent of search and shared at equal policy and verification size
initial_recommendation: also record the initial choice with that arm's final verifier size, to separate same-verifier search increments from the equal-total-budget initial-only control
report: all cells, true expected and independently realized verified reward, initial/final choices, risk ablation, finite-bank feasibility, costs and terminal Gaussian projection gap
independent_units: two task laws; three budget strata and four arms are paired, not 24 independent tasks
checkpoint_unit: complete task law, 12 cells; CPU limit checked between task laws, with complete blocks reused on resume
scientific_status: bounded prospective development pilot, one source archive; tests incremental search and risk-prior value, not full method versus mature baselines
dispatch: local single thread only; no server tasks
